method.distributions: Recomputed from every native tick, without removing cold startup, GC-related, or scheduling outliers; nearest-rank quantiles exactly match the probe.
method.strata: all: 14400 ticks; planning: native ownerPlans nonempty; nonPlanning: native ownerPlans empty. Whole/sim/AI distributions remain separate.
method.pairedContrasts: A1 versus B1, A2 versus B2. Positive reductionPercent means a smaller candidate statistic. No significance test or confidence interval.
method.runStatisticAverages: Arithmetic mean of two independent run statistics per A/B group. Averaged p95/p99/max are averages of per-run values, never pooled-distribution quantiles or maxima.
method.effectAttribution: A combined candidate comparison establishes neither an isolated optimization effect nor a universal performance guarantee.
method.sourceIdentity: Source inputs compare relative src paths, bytes, and SHA256; git identity, status, probe identity, and emitted bundle identities are also retained. Bundles can differ because frozen source directories differ.
method.memory: RSS and heapUsed are sampled process memory, not allocation counts. sampledMaximumBytes is only the maximum of recorded samples. Post-run GC was not standardized; no conclusion of memory reduction is made.
method.timingBoundary: wholeMs excludes separately timed currentSnapshot, command serialization/hash observer and disk output. simMs and aiMs measure actual stepGame and native AI boundaries; frameMs overlaps them.
method.gcAttribution: Performance comparison keeps diagnostics off. These runs contain no per-tick GC attribution; no causal GC label is inferred from timing alone.
